question: Should this live-lane outage enter ideation as a durable-decisions release blocker, with local host proof required before one CI confirmation?
summary: Approve ideation and keep the prerelease blocked. PR #565 introduced the outage, but the filed diagnosis needs two corrections: recorded-gate-lifecycle became an approved cross-host acceptance obligation and must not be withdrawn, while gate-guardrail was substantially rewritten by #565 so the last green run does not prove the strengthened oracle ever passed. Ideation must classify each current failure from durable artifacts: gate binding/cardinality, root review presentation versus extraction, rejection rework, and post-approval dispatch. Preserve the existing value obligations, fix conduct or the oracle according to the governing contract, and prohibit compatibility work, prompt coaching, scenario quarantine, new harnesses, or CI-led iteration. Focused tests must pass under local isolated Claude, Codex, and Pi authentication; then the complete local live suites and Roborev must pass before one pushed CI run.

artifacts.summary: Filed outage diagnosis and reproduction evidence; ideation must correct its newcomer/regression classification before implementation.

routes.label: Correct the recovery boundary before ideation
